## What is 3alamiy Web3?

3alamiy Web3 is a free crypto airdrop tracking platform. It provides verified, step-by-step participation guides for cryptocurrency airdrops. All content is free — no paywalls, no subscriptions.

## Key Features

- 75+ verified crypto airdrops with step-by-step guides
- Filter by blockchain, difficulty, and cost
- GM Station: daily on-chain activity across 16+ EVM chains in one click
- Email newsletter and Telegram bot for instant airdrop alerts
- 20+ educational articles on airdrop strategies
- Magic link login with personal favorites tracking
